operations.content:
import subprocess,json
u='prediction-a2z-v4-model@A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2.service'
p=subprocess.run(['journalctl','--user','-u',u,'--since','2026-10-07 21:13:15','--until','2026-10-07 21:13:26','--no-pager'],capture_output=True,text=True)
rows=[]
for line in (p.stdout or '').splitlines():
    if 'SUPERVISOR_STATE' not in line: continue
    i=line.find('{')
    if i<0: continue
    try:o=json.loads(line[i:])
    except Exception as e:
        rows.append({'parse_error':type(e).__name__,'raw':line[i:][-500:]})
        continue
    rows.append({k:o.get(k) for k in ('event','state','task_id','reason','attempt','checkpoint','retry_at','next_action')})
print('ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_TEMPFAIL_STATEJSON',flush=True)
print('ERROR='+json.dumps(rows,separators=(',',':'),sort_keys=True),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1)
